title: GR00T agent trajectory
description: One ordered account of what a GR00T suite agent run did, normalized across agents so the distillation pipeline needs a single reader. Producers outside the xagents repository write this document and hand the file over; xagents validates it with xagents.trajectory.ingest.load_trajectory.

schema_version.description: The versioned contract. A producer that cannot be updated in lockstep keeps working only while this string is stable.

agent_type.description: Which suite agent produced the run.

run_id.description: The producer's id for this run. Carries the record's identity through the hand-off.

task.description: What the run was asked to do, in the requester's words.

inputs.description: What the whole run was pinned to: faq's corpus_version, research's base_commit / eval_metric / direction / min_delta / baseline_score, debug's repo_commit / report_sha256. Run-scoped, so a consumer reads them here rather than off whichever step happens to carry them.

terminal_status.description: How the run ended, or null while it is still open. awaiting_evidence is the debug runner's waiting; cancelled is a run a human stopped.

steps.description: The run's steps in the order they happened.

phase.description: Where in its loop the run was. The allowed values depend on agent_type; see the conditional schemas below.

summary.description: One line a human can read. Never the only home for a fact the pipeline needs: anything a consumer must act on belongs in a field.

status.description: Whether this step's outcome is usable as evidence. ok covers a hypothesis tested and rejected; failed is the step's own execution dying, which says nothing about the question it asked; waiting needs an input from a human; blocked needs the environment or the frozen evidence restored.

unit_id.description: The loop iteration this step belongs to: a debug hypothesis-to-verify cycle, or a research trial.

parent_unit_id.description: The unit this one descends from. Must name a unit_id an earlier step declares.

evidence_refs.description: Paths or URIs to the logs, artifacts and diffs this step produced or read.
